relevance_note: Family report of four male relatives with Danon disease carrying a LAMP2 missense variant: "The proband (III-1) and three of the four cousins (III-2, III-4, III-5) had Danon disease caused by a missense mutation".
method_note: Read by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and sliced Table 1 row spans from the paper text (checked against the table). Table 1 has patients as rows; columns: LAMP2 mutation, Mental Retardation, Muscle weakness, Cardio-myopathy, CRD, BCVA, Color vision, Macula, Periphery, Goldmann Perimetry, ERG. The table legend does not define '−'; so '−' cells (Mental Retardation for all four, Cardio-myopathy for III-1, III-2, III-4, CRD for III-2 and III-4) were not used as exclusions; CRD absence for III-2/III-4 comes from the text instead. '+' cells were read as present. 'Normal' cells (colour vision, macula, periphery, ERG) recorded as excluded abnormalities per D-27; III-2/III-4 'abnormal electroretinogram' excluded from the ERG 'Normal' cell (span is the whole row). III-3 (cousin, unaffected, tested negative for LAMP2) is included as a tested relative with no variant row. The daughter of III-5 (died at 29 of cardiomyopathy) is included as an affected relative, untested, no variant row. The two daughters of III-4 ('appeared to be non-affected', untested) are out of scope and get no rows. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in III-5 was not mapped to the 'left ventricular hypertrophy' checklist item; generic 'muscle weakness' (III-1, III-5) was not mapped to 'proximal muscle weakness'; III-2 'weakness of the shoulder, upper arm' was mapped to proximal weakness. Zygosity not stated (no 'hemizygous'); inheritance and parental testing not reported. Sex for III-2 from 'the four affected males' (Discussion). Possible prior report: III-1's history and the variant cite reference [8] (van der Kooi 2008), but the paper does not state that these patients were described there, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Contradiction: the Abstract calls III-2/III-4 'two siblings' and III-1 'the third sibling', while Methods/Results call III-2..III-5 cousins of the proband; Methods says 'his three cousins with Danon' while Results lists four cousins (III-2 to III-5, one unaffected).
